title: Violation
description: One finding of one rule: a reference to the rule, the observation of what is wrong, and where it is reported. The reporting script renders the comment as '{observation} breaks {principle name}', the principle being the parent of the rule referenced; the observation itself names no rule and no principle. The anchor is a line or a range inside the surface, or the pull request as a whole where no surface line is to blame, including code the change made dead elsewhere, which the observation names by file and line. The observation states what is wrong, not how to fix it

examples.observation: Losing the check's exit status in a pipe into tail

rule.description: A reference to the rule violated, by its id: the rule of the ledger row carrying this violation. The reporting script reads the rule's parent principle through it

Observation.description: What the code does wrong, briefly, worded as the subject of the sentence the reporting script completes: '{observation} breaks {principle name}'. It names no rule and no principle, by name, id, link, or wording

Side.description: RIGHT for a line of the file at the head commit, LEFT for a line removed from the base

Line.description: One line of one file, numbered in the file on the side named, never as a diff hunk offset

Lines.description: Consecutive lines of one file on one side

PullRequest.description: The pull request as a whole: an existing component that replaces a whole module, a standard the change set as a whole does not follow, or code outside the surface that the change made dead, named by file and line in the observation. Carried in the review body rather than on a line
